notes.title: Riot Control Simulator: ROOKIE DAY IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day is out now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535680/Riot_Control_Simulator_Rookie_Day/

🚓 Get your first taste of law enforcement duty in Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day, the free prologue to the full Riot Control Simulator experience. Step into the boots of a rookie officer managing security during minor riots caused by pseudo-fans after a match. 

👮‍♂️ Coordinate with your squad, set up barriers, manage crowds, and handle aggressive individuals using tools like batons, tasers, or gas. Your mission: keep the streets safe without escalating the violence.
